analysis_status: designed after the gain-versus-loss opportunity-axis asymmetry was observed; hypothesis-generating robustness only
question: Does the endpoint reversal in marginal opportunity information persist across stricter spatial matching and stricter observed-link frequency thresholds?

contexts.weekly_k1: week-level focal-response-excluded opportunity; any positive annual visit defines a link
contexts.weekly_k2: same weekly predictors; >=2 annual visits define a link
contexts.weekly_k3: same weekly predictors; >=3 annual visits define a link
contexts.siteweek_k1: same-site same-week focal-response-excluded opportunity; any positive annual visit defines a link

models.full_marginal: plant opportunity axis + pollinator opportunity axis
models.metric: held-out log-loss penalty when each axis is removed

directional_hypothesis.gain: pollinator-axis removal penalty > plant-axis removal penalty
directional_hypothesis.loss: plant-axis removal penalty > pollinator-axis removal penalty

promotion_rule: Describe the reversal as robust hypothesis-generating predictive information only if the expected direction holds in all 3 primary folds under every frozen context.
claim_ceiling: Post-result robustness of a predictive-information asymmetry only. It does not establish distinct causal assembly/disassembly mechanisms, sampling-effort independence, behavioral causation, decision equivalence, or routeability.
